o.text: Reborrowed from Classical Persian تیز (tēz), ultimately from Proto-Turkic *teŕ-, doublet of Azerbaijani təzmək. Cognate with Crimean Tatar tez, Kazakh тез (tez), Tatar тиз (tiz), Uzbek tez, Chuvash тар (tar, “to run away”).
From Arabic عَوْرَة (ʕawra). Doublet of arvad.
